title: Projects

create.title: New project

create.folderHint: Absolute path. The server validates the folder exists before saving.
create.nameHint: Leave blank to use the last two path segments.
create.errorConflict: A project with this name or folder already exists.
create.errorInvalid: Invalid folder — check if the path exists.
edit.title: Edit project
edit.rootPathHint: Absolute path to the code folder. Update if you moved the project.
edit.groupEmptyLabel: Type to create a new group
edit.groupHint: Groups related projects in the listing. Leave blank for no grouping.
edit.deleteConfirm: Remove <bold>{{name}}</bold> from the index? Files will not be deleted.
edit.embeddingsHint: When disabled, this project uses full-text search only.
edit.memoryHint: Distills durable memory (decisions, gotchas, recipes) when sessions compact or go idle, and recalls it in future sessions. Uses the general default AI model unless a memory_extraction binding overrides it.
edit.searchModeHint: The default search strategy for this project. Can be overridden per query.
runs.title: Run Index
runs.description: Analyze the project with an LLM provider/model and watch progress in real time.
runs.noModels: No models registered for {{kind}}. Add models in the <bold>Admin</bold> tab.
runs.configureProvider: Configure a provider in the <bold>Admin</bold> tab first.
runs.embeddings.title: Embeddings
runs.embeddings.description: Vectors for semantic search. Retry re-embeds only missing records.
snapshots.title: Context Snapshots
snapshots.deleteDescription: The snapshot and its version history will be permanently removed.
snapshotDiff.tooLarge: This file is too large or binary to diff hunk-by-hunk.
snapshotDiff.largeFileHint: You can still revert the whole file or accept it as-is.
snapshotPanel.revertFile.title: Revert file?
snapshotPanel.revertFile.description: This will restore {{file}} to its session baseline (or delete it if it was created during the session). Cannot be undone from this UI.
snapshotPanel.keepAll.description: Closes every active snapshot for this session. Files keep their current on-disk contents.
snapshotPanel.revertAll.description: Restores every active baseline to disk (files created during the session get deleted). Cannot be undone.
snapshotPanel.autoReview.none: Automatic review finished with no findings.
snapshotPanel.reviewSent_one: Sent {{count}} review item to the chat.
snapshotPanel.reviewSent_other: Sent {{count}} review items to the chat.
snapshotPanel.reviewSentMaster_one: Sent {{count}} review item to the master.
snapshotPanel.reviewSentMaster_other: Sent {{count}} review items to the master.
snapshotPanel.reviewPending: Review saved, but the master is waiting for an interactive answer — respond to it (or interject) so it picks up the feedback.
snapshotPanel.reviewUndelivered: Review saved, but there is no active master to deliver it to. Start the session and send again.
snapshotPanel.title: Snapshots
snapshotPanel.selectFile: Select a file to view its diff.
